<parameter=code>
def state():
    a = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    sq = {}
    for r in range(8, 50):
        for c in range(38, 48):
            if a[r][c] in 'RbN':
                sq.setdefault(a[r][c], []).append(r)
    mrows = [r for r in range(64) if 'M' in a[r][10:17]]
    cable = {}
    for r in range(10, 44):
        cells = [c for c in range(16, 48) if a[r][c] in 'wg']
        if cells: cable[r] = (min(cells), max(cells))
    return (mrows[0], mrows[-1]) if mrows else None, cable, {k:(min(v),max(v)) for k,v in sq.items()}

# retract to min
for _ in range(6): action(['LEFT'])
print('min', state())
# climb as high as possible at min cable
for i in range(6):
    before = state()[0]
    action(['UP'])
    after = state()[0]
    print('UP', i, before, '->', after)
    if before == after: break
print('final', state())
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
